question: Should this umbrella issue remain the canonical product tracker for Linux/Windows companion apps, or should maintainers split it into platform-specific canonical issues now that Windows Hub exists and Linux still lacks a native companion?
rationale: Current main partially resolves the Windows side but not Linux, while open Linux PRs carry large security-sensitive platform choices that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Keep umbrella canonical
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad cross-platform companion-app tracker until Linux app direction and Windows scorecard/docs status are both resolved.

options.title: Split by platform
options.body: Designate separate Linux and Windows canonical issues, then close this issue only after both links preserve the remaining scope and related PRs are routed.

options.title: Defer alternate app shells
options.body: Keep Windows Hub as the official Windows path and route alternate desktop app variants to external repositories unless a maintainer sponsors them.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella canonical
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad cross-platform companion-app tracker until Linux app direction and Windows scorecard/docs status are both resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the umbrella tracker and has the strongest visible product-direction signal for the platform app boundary.
